title: Ancient Halls 3D Game Experiment
author: geekichu
selftext:
My first game.  Started with ChatGPT, moved onto Google Gemini, ended up with Claude.Code.

Not going to compete with all the amazing graphics  I see in games.  This is fully home-grown from scratch, no 3rd party libs.

Converted to client-server as an exercise in protecting  intellectual property, and it also buys me being able to do a players' stats board.

To me it was more important to have a challenging game that makes you think, strategize, inquire, persevere. 

The graphics are all browser canvas.

Server  is at render.com, client is at netlify.com.

My contribution was to maintain tight architectural control - no vibe coding.

Forced A.I. to have spec docs, plan docs,  progress docs, engineering craft docs  automated tests, and I  had it build local cli admin tools for me as well.

More recently am learning to orchestrate, so example:  Fable  is my 'Lead'..  and it manages Opus and Sonnet.  That way I can extend the usage.
